ability.name: Active Directory BloodHound Collection
ability.description: Runs SharpHound collector to produce deep relationship mapping data inside the domain.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { SharpHound.exe --CollectionMethods Default --OutputDirectory $d } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\sharphound_out.txt

rationale: Generates the necessary bloodhound output file required to proceed beyond standard AD enumeration.
